points: “Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast”: that’s all those lands along the sea. “The nation of the Cherethites!”: that’s talking about the Palestinians. Write that down: the Palestinians are the Cherethites today. “The word of the Lord is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines”: the land of the Palestinians. Philistines and Palestinians is the same word; they just use it differently.

“Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast”: Gaza, Ashkelon, Ashdod, Tel Aviv, that’s all sea coast. “The nation of the Cherethites!” The Cherethites are the Palestinians; write that down. The Palestinians are going to get the work too; they ain’t getting spared.
